evidence_items.explanation: The paper demonstrates extraction of personal information and transmission through Markdown image requests in tested agents. Its archived version appeared October 19; contemporaneous reporting in e2 establishes that this research had already been disclosed on October 17.

The article documents the research's public disclosure and reports that Mistral blocked external image loading, with researcher confirmation. This limits any implication of continuing vulnerability in that product; a separately accessible primary remediation notice was not found.
